text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
What an upset, it's Nakayama Festa! 
Nakayama Festa takes 1st place!!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"...Did you see it? That special 
scenery...?"

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah. Just a little... Together with 
everything you guys have been carrying.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Then... that's a relief. Ehehe, phew~...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Please keep going. Just like that. El-chan 
is waiting for you.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Haha... How harsh. Making me walk without 
even a moment to rest.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, that's right! The path you walk is a 
steep one!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: So... do your best, okay!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: …………Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Thanks.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... *sigh*~ I gave it everything I 
had~............

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Ehehe... But to lose after all that...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: ...Man, it really does sting...

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Nakayama Festa...!? Not Special Week, but 
Nakayama Festa took 1st place...!?

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Nakayama Festa is that Umamusume who 
picked a fight with El Condor Pasa before, 
right? Wait, is that right?
(Murmur... murmur, murmur...!)

Once Nakayama Festa reached the winner's 
circle, she took a deep breath.

For a split second, my eyes met hers. 
Sensing what she was about to do, I gave a 
silent nod.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: How about that, El Condor Pasa?!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
I just conquered the commander of your 
generation! So stop sitting on your 
laurels and come down here!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"That 'world' you failed to seize— this 
time, I will claim it for myself!!"

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
Wha, she's at it again...! She just picked 
a fight with El Condor Pasa!

text_block_list.name: Spectator D
text_block_list.text:
C-Come on, really~? Didn't you say the 
same thing last year, and ended up not 
registering for the 'Prix de l'Arc de 
Triomphe'?

text_block_list.name: Spectator D
text_block_list.text:
Surely this is just more big talk, like 
old times. Bringing up the world just to 
stand out...

text_block_list.name: Spectator E
text_block_list.text:
Still, right now, she just beat Special 
Week and took 1st place, didn't she?

text_block_list.name: Spectator D
text_block_list.text: ...That may be true, but...

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
So could it really be...? N-No, no! But 
even if I get my hopes up again—

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Absurd! Utterly preposterous! You have far 
too much attituuuude, YES!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Do you understand just how high a wall the 
world is!?

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Wait, El Condor Pasa!?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Ever since that day I challenged it! Ever 
since that day I almost seized glory, 
coming within half a horse length!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
"Even though no other Umamusume had come 
closer to the pinnacle than her!!"

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
...! That's right, that's right! Even our 
hero couldn't reach the 'Prix de l'Arc de 
Triomphe'!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Can you really surpass El Condor Pasa's 
feats?! That's just impossible—

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Because it's so absurd, wouldn't it be 
incredible if we actually pulled it off?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Haha... Looks like the standard set by El 
remains pretty monumental. Whenever racing 
overseas comes up, it's always El this, El 
that, as usual.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
—Then I'll drown out all those voices with 
'Nakayama Festa.'

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"What are you guys gonna do? Just keep 
dreaming of the past?!"

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
That may be your choice, then! However, I 
shall pursue the greatest hope!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
I'll reach a future that nobody can 
predict! Even if it's just a 1% chance, 
I'll rip that future right into my hands!!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: ...Bueno.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
"That declaration just now was heard not 
only by everyone here, but surely by 
people all across Japan through their TVs 
and the internet!"

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Understood! If you say you will show me a 
new future!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Go ahead and try to surpass me at my 
best!! We'll settle this at the Japan Cup, 
yeeees!!
(WOOOOOOAAAAAAAHHH!)

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, did you hear!? Nakayama Festa's 
declaration! What should we do, go watch 
the Japan Cup?!

text_block_list.name: Passerby B
text_block_list.text:
Of course I'm going! I mean, I get to take 
on El Condor Pasa for real, you know?!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Waaah, another globally ambitious 
Umamusume has appeared! Is your ultimate 
goal the "Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe"!?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Yes, absolutely! If you're saying she 
managed to surpass El Condor Pasa, then 
that strength must truly be the real deal!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Former Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text: ...Festa, are you aware?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Former Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text:
The gamble you're about to make right 
now... is about to become the hope of all 
of Japan.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: ...Exquisitely done.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...Likewise.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Fufun! I'm going to forge a body of steel 
for the Japan Cup!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, let's meet at Tokyo Racecourse next 
time. See ya, El.
choice_data_list:
Are you sure you want to give such a cold 
greeting?

Are you sure you want to give such a curt 
greeting?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
We're gonna be fighting neck-and-neck in 
races. What's the point of playing 
buddy-buddy forever?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: I'm heading back ahead of ya, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Jeez, Nakayama-senpai is truly a free 
spirit, desu!
choice_data_list:
...Thank you so much for everything up 
until today.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
No! There's no need to thank me! The real 
deal is just getting started, right?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Come at me to crush me, don't hold back! 
That way, I can strike you right back 
without holding back either.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I won't be cutting any corners 
whatsoever.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I need you to surpass El at full power, 
Nakayama-senpai, or else I'll be in 
trouble.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Pheeew...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
"Because as someone who shows hope to 
others, I want her to face it in a state 
where she can actually inspire it."

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"...Going out of your way to spare your 
own time for this. Even summoning Special 
Week."

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Plus, a certain someone told me to bet my 
very life. And another certain someone 
said they'd go down to hell with me.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"Fine then... Just as you wanted, I'll go 
all-in against all of you together."

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
I wonder just how high the stakes are 
gonna be for this next gamble.

"And the gears of a new destiny began to 
turn. Heading toward the 'Japan Cup.'"
